description: Generations/facelifts of a model, with production years. This answers from a fixed 40-car demo set. Full catalogue: pay per request with x402, no key (GET /v1/variants/{id}/specs $0.05, /v1/search $0.005, /v1/variants $0.005, /v1/compare $0.1, USDC on Base); the Apify Actor, billed per event by Apify (https://apify.com/carsdatacom/car-specs-api); or the whole database as a licensed export (https://cars-data.com/en/api).

locale.description: Response language, one of the 20 published languages (en, ro, fr, de, es, it, sr, hr, pt, pl, cs, sk, hu, no, sv, el, bg, da, ar, tr). Spec labels and enum values come back translated. Default: en.

model_id.description: Opaque model id from a search_cars or filter_cars result, e.g. m_1a2b3c4d

name: list_generations

years.description: Production years, e.g. '2019–2024'; '2021–' is still in production

title: List generations of a model
